scripts.test-pgsql: docker compose -f tests/Pgsql/compose.yaml run --rm --build --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" php; status=$?; docker compose -f tests/Pgsql/compose.yaml down; exit $status

scripts-descriptions.test-pgsql: Run the pgsql suite (CDR SQL and the App Defaults index) on PostgreSQL in Docker
scripts-descriptions.coverage: Run the tests with code coverage (needs Xdebug) and write an HTML report to build/coverage/html
